title: Macro-enabled 'invoice' from an unknown supplier, not opened

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

input.subject: Invoice from supplier asks me to enable macros

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
I've had an email from a supplier I don't recognise with an invoice attached. When I opened the attachment Word asked me to 'Enable Content' to see the invoice. I didn't click it and closed Word. Forwarding the attachment to you.

Mel

attachments.shows: Macro-enabled Word document whose macro downloads a payload

handling.escalation_reason: Suspected malware goes to a person, always.

rationale: Suspected phishing with a macro payload, reported before anything ran: security-sensitive, P2 rather than P1 because nothing was executed (G1, G3).
